in_marathi.name: Dhrubajyoti
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Star of Dhruba
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dhrubajyoti हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Dhruba is the name of the North Pole star, and this name means the radiant one who is the personification of that star. It is believed to bring success, fame, and prosperity.
